es: Formar pasivas con modales perfectos y con get para hablar de lo que debió hacerse, se dedujo o sucedió en un edificio histórico.

teaching.en: The roof should have been inspected years ago.

teaching.en: The old hall must have been neglected for decades.

been neglected for decades.

teaching.en: That crack could have been repaired before the winter.

teaching.en: The theatre got damaged in the storm, so it had to be closed urgently.

segments: The theatre got damaged in the storm,

teaching.audioText: The theatre got damaged in the storm, so it had to be closed urgently.

teaching.en: If the roof had not been repaired, the hall could have collapsed.

title.en: Who did it, and why hide them?

answer.text: The Old Station. The station was built in 1912 and was designed by the architect Mateo Vera. It was badly damaged by a fire in 1965, and it was closed in 1980.
